label: provides index type
type: the subject service is the engine that produces and maintains the object index type.
note: Note the hole this predicate has by construction: Views are the only index kind on indexes.md with no providing service - they are produced by a deprecated engine the page does not name. An ontology that assumes every index type has a provider will be wrong exactly there.
relates_to_competency_question: Which service provides this kind of index?
